about: Which changed files decide how deeply a pull request is reviewed. The highest tier of any changed file wins: tier 2 gets the full review, tier 0 is documents only, and anything not listed is tier 1. Read by bsf-server/scripts/review-tier.js. What each tier means is in .claude/skills/bsf-review/SKILL.md.
